notes: C5 is judged 'partly' because P24 critiques assuming the exponential form in Eq. 1 and asks to test it against the theoretical modified-Bessel K1(r/lambda) form for exchange-mediated overlap rather than asking for an analytical derivation. C2 is judged 'not raised' as P22 only requests an isolated-skyrmion control to rule out pinning in the recoil analysis rather than comparing lattice regimes with single-skyrmion regimes. C16 is judged 'partly' via P10 (robustness of a* and b* across lattice configurations), as the review does not ask about pairwise vs many-body interactions.
